{"code": "import pandas as pd

# Load the data
sales = pd.read_csv('data/sales.csv')

# Inspect the revenue column to confirm it's stored as string with commas
print("First 5 values of revenue:")
print(sales['revenue'].head())

# Check for the presence of commas
print("\nAre commas present in revenue values?", sales['revenue'].str.contains(',', regex=False).any())

# Check for the six QA orders with 999999.99
print("\nNumber of rows with revenue == '999999.99'", (sales['revenue'] == '999999.99').sum())"}
